arc.fallback: Fire and Ice, Jonathan and Dio

description.fallback: Thinking that the both of them will die on the sinking ship, Erina shares one last passionate kiss with her husband Jonathan. However, as she finishes, Jonathan points to a baby nearby whose mother had been killed by the zombies, and tells Erina to live on. Erina objects, but Jonathan tells her that he is asking her to do it because his own mother died in the same way as this unknown woman: protecting her child.

outro.fallback: Though she didn't know it at the time Erina was pregnant with their child.
After two days, Erina and the baby are rescued from the waters near the Canary Islands.
